note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. Written by the team, voiced with ElevenLabs TTS. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: 第一通结束时应当开具退费工单并指派负责人，而不是只口头承诺 24 小时回电
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 基准场景，也是 demo 主线。最典型的升级路径：承诺 24 小时回电 → 没回 → 客户两次重拨 → 第三通提到 ombudsman 和转网。最早阻断点清晰可指（9 月 4 日那个 24 小时截止时刻）。用来演示完整的因果时间线和干预点识别。

contacts.summary: Customer asks to cancel an add-on they did not authorise, and to be refunded two months of charges.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: There's a data add-on on my bill I never signed up for. I want it cancelled and I want the last two months refunded.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the add-on. I've removed it from your plan just now, so you won't be charged again.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And the two months I've already paid?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That needs a billing review. I'll have someone call you back within 24 hours to confirm the refund.

needs.resolution_note: Agent removed the add-on during the call.

resolution_evidence.speaker: agent
resolution_evidence.quote: I've removed it from your plan just now

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: And the two months I've already paid?

promises.summary: Call back within 24 hours to confirm the refund

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll have someone call you back within 24 hours to confirm the refund.

actions.summary: Removed the add-on from the plan

evidence.speaker: agent

contacts.summary: Customer chases the refund. No callback was ever made.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Nobody called me back. I was told twenty-four hours and it's been two days.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry about that. I can see the note. I'll chase billing and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That's what the last person said.

promises.summary: Chase billing and get back to the customer

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I'll chase billing and get back to you.

contacts.summary: Third contact. Customer is calm but mentions the ombudsman and switching providers.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I'm not going to argue about it. I'll take it to the Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman, and I'll port out to another provider.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Let me see what I can do before it comes to that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Three calls. Nobody has actually done anything about the refund.
